verdict.rationale: The docs give one concrete usage limit: each source can hold up to 500,000 words or 200MB. They also show that paid subscriptions exist, since paid owners of public notebooks get usage analytics, and that the product is a core service for Workspace and Education users. Nothing in the pack lays out plan pricing or tier differences, so a researcher could not fully assess cost before committing. Missing for 10: a pricing page or plan comparison, free-vs-paid tier limits (notebook, source and daily generation quotas), actual prices, and independent corroboration of limits.
